## Quantify components of biological systems

Bulk tissues mix cell populations. Autoimmunity and cancer change both
**composition** and **state** of those populations
[@schnellImmune2020].

![Immune balance as a seesaw between regulation and inflammation.](images/figures/fig-immune-balance.png){#fig-immune-balance fig-alt="Three seesaws: healthy balance, cancer under-reaction, inflammatory over-reaction."}

::: {.attribution}
@schnellImmune2020
:::

## Holistic complexity

Genes cooperate in pathways; metabolites and cell populations interact
in bio-molecular networks. Deconvolution alone is not enough — we need
**structure** on the gene side as well [@schnellImmune2020].

![Holistic view: transcriptome and cell populations feed immune balance.](images/figures/fig-holistic-networks.png){#fig-holistic fig-alt="Seesaw diagram with transcriptome and cell-population inputs."}

::: {.attribution}
@schnellImmune2020
:::

## Technical alternatives

![Bulk versus single-cell trade-offs.](images/figures/fig-bulk-vs-sc.png){#fig-bulk-vs-sc fig-alt="Comparison of bulk RNA-seq and single-cell / spatial assays."}

::::: columns
::: {.column width="50%"}
**Bulk RNA-seq**

- Cheaper, larger cohorts
- Longitudinal studies
- Aggregates heterogeneous signals
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
**Single-cell / spatial**

- Resolve rare types & lineages
- Costly, noisy, heavy compute
- Complements bulk rather than replaces it
:::
:::::

Deconvolution recovers cell-type proportions from bulk when single-cell
is impractical at scale.
